hero_kpi_rationale: Operating margin retained as the master KPI for demonstrating industrial performance and cost management despite inflation, a key element of the group's profitable growth trajectory.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves thanks to strict cost management and portfolio transformation.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin increases slightly, supported by higher-value-added solutions.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment, plants, or production capacity.
kpis.description: The group is investing over $400 million over four years in the United States to expand its production capacity in insulation, roofing, and plasterboard.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to strengthen capacity in insulation and roofing.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the group worldwide.
kpis.description: The group is adjusting its workforce while maintaining its HR attractiveness with the Top Employer Global label.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount adjustment in the context of transformation.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 46.48 Bn EUR last year
